messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Meyers <alex@cascadia-ai.com>, sales_ops@cascadia-ai.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Engineering deep-dive: 60–90min — attendee poll & prep

Hi Alex — thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap: Cascadia is prioritizing lower-tail latency for production prompts and needs predictable throughput for batch ingestion. You confirmed ML model size (~13B), peak concurrent users ~120, and a short list of compliance concerns (audit logs + regional isolation).

Next step I propose: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/infra leads to walk architecture, integration paths, and an initial mutual action plan. To make scheduling fast, please pick whichever of the three windows below works for the core engineering crew (we'll convert to your timezone and lock a calendar invite):

- Option A: Tue Jun 15 — 09:00–10:30 PT (16:00–17:30 CET)
- Option B: Wed Jun 16 — 13:00–14:30 PT (20:00–21:30 CET)
- Option C: Thu Jun 17 — 11:00–12:30 PT (18:00–19:30 CET)

Who we suggest attend from your side: 1x ML lead (model/serving), 1x Platform/SRE, product owner for integration requirements. From Redwood we'll bring Rishi (serving runtime), Lauren (solutions / integration), and Connor (SRE).

Agenda (draft):
- 5 min: goals + success criteria for the session
- 20 min: Cascadia production workload and prompt patterns (your team)
- 25 min: Redwood runtime architecture & serving tradeoffs
- 20–40 min: integration paths, KV/prefix caching, and quantization options + Q/A
- 5–10 min: mutual action plan and next milestones

Attached is a short precall questionnaire and an initial MAP workbook — please fill the questionnaire if possible; it helps us prioritize the integration paths during the call.

If you want me to include any additional stakeholders (e.g., security or procurement), reply with names and emails and we'll add them to the invite.

Thanks — would love to lock this by EOD Friday so teams can block calendars.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: tdx-precall-questions.pdf (2 pages), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (workbook)
